title: rollup-plugin-terser is deprecated
summary: npm marks rollup-plugin-terser as deprecated: "This package has been deprecated and is no longer maintained. Please use @rollup/plugin-terser"

constraints: Preserve minification options, source maps, and the assets each Rollup build emits.

steps.title: Replace the Rollup Terser plugin
steps.instructions: Replace rollup-plugin-terser with @rollup/plugin-terser in dependencies and the Rollup configuration, and keep the current terser options.

steps.title: Verify bundle output
steps.instructions: Compare size, source maps, and runtime behavior of every minified output with the previous build.

verification.purpose: Build every Rollup output with the maintained Terser plugin.
